QuestInfo.name: [Preparing for Winter] Food Keeps You Warm
QuestInfo.1: Winter is coming, and you need to prepare for frigid weather! The Maple Administrator suggested eating some healthy food to stay warm. Bring #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to her, and she'll give you something to keep you healthy.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to the Maple Administrator to prepare for cold winter weather. In return, you received a title and a buff that makes your body healthier.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. It's getting colder, isn't it?\nWinter is almost upon us, and TKTKTK is when it gets REALLY cold! You should prepare, so you don't freeze up.\nSome nice, healthy food would help... Ooh, I know! We need Drumsticks!

yes.0: Glad you agree! Now, the monsters of Maple World stock up on #bNutritious Drumsticks#k this time of the year for the same reasons that we want them. Of course, monsters don't deserve nice things, so please beat them up, and bring me #b10 of their Nutritious Drumsticks#k. I'll give you something really good for your health if you do, #h0#.

no.0: What, you don't like Drumsticks? They're so nutritious, though! I know this great recipe...
